$comment: Machine-checkable part of the closed-loop workflow contract.
Each clause names the decision it enforces, the files that must carry it, and literal
substrings that must appear in those files. Literal matching is deliberate: the prose
of the skills and prompts is the deliverable, so rewording a contract clause must fail
the build until the change is intentional.

A clause without a "section" is matched against the whole file, which is weaker than it looks: a literal deleted from one place can still match an unrelated mention elsewhere. Record formats are pinned whole and scoped to a section for that reason.

clauses.title: Gate verdicts are supplied by the caller, not by agent files
requires: MERGE | FIX BEFORE MERGE | NEEDS DECISION
Do not modify any file under `agents/`
terra-oracle` has no verdict contract of its own
A missing or unparsable verdict is a tool-level failure

clauses.title: Gate verdicts are supplied by the caller, not by agent files
requires: MERGE | FIX BEFORE MERGE | NEEDS DECISION
Do not modify any file under `agents/`

clauses.title: Every constraint is restated in the invocation payload
requires: Nothing may rely on a child inheriting this skill
acceptance criteria the target must satisfy
on a gate re-invocation, every finding from that gate's earlier rounds
out-of-scope improvement rather than a blocker

clauses.title: Writer selection
requires: Do not fall back to another worker
keeps the closed-loop requirement inside one model family

clauses.title: Do not use context.md / plan.md
pi-subagents is a hard runtime dependency
requires: If `pi-subagents` is unavailable, stop and report `BLOCKED`

clauses.title: Mode token parsing is exact and fails closed
requires: final token of the raw argument vector
no token remains once the target reference is consumed

clauses.title: Mode token parsing is restated in the prompt template
Target kind is verified, never assumed
requires: Verify that the resolved target is the expected kind
never inferred from the current branch

clauses.title: Targets outside the current repository
A foreign review-only target needs no checkout and refuses mutation
requires: no local Git object or checkout is required
Autofix and every publication action refuse such a target

clauses.title: Authoritative comments and fingerprints
requires: Never estimate or invent a digest value

clauses.title: Issue fingerprint serialization is byte-stable
Pull-request fingerprints are evidence specific
requires: without fetch, checkout, or git-state mutation

clauses.title: Candidate evidence covers the uncommitted autofix overlay
requires: change detection within a single run
this MVP does not create commits
Do not commit, push, or otherwise mutate git state

clauses.title: External observation has an explicit origin
requires: observation origin is part of resumable state
only a new head resets them

clauses.title: The validated pi-subagents minimum version is documented
requires: do not assume support for older versions

Round accounting
Round budgets are run-scoped (known MVP limitation)
requires: Do not create a state file

The issue status block marks publication as not applicable
Canonical status tokens
requires: the approved specification is the published specification

clauses.title: Canonical status tokens
requires: Never declare `MERGE_READY` while the candidate is unpublished

clauses.title: Scratch-file boundary
Language Profile package defaults
requires: stop and ask before drafting content for that destination

clauses.title: SonarCloud disposition in the MVP
requires: must not be declared on the basis of a transition that was never performed

clauses.title: External observation is reported, not enforced
Precondition guard
Precondition guard
Issue closed-loop model requirements and preflight
PR closed-loop model requirements and preflight

requires: stop rather than continue against a moved target

clauses.title: A normal commit under the publication grant follows the project convention
Sequential Sol then Terra gates
requires: Never start the Terra gate before the Sol gate returns `MERGE`

clauses.title: Finding disposition values
requires:
fixed
accepted-as-designed
deferred
duplicate
not-applicable
needs-owner-decision

clauses.title: The issue finding record names every field
requires: For each finding record the source gate, severity, the `issue_spec` it was raised against, evidence, impact, the disposition, the rationale, the revised passage when the disposition is `fixed`, validation evidence that the revision actually resolves the finding, and the reply or status URL once the operator has posted it.

clauses.title: The pull-request finding record names every field
requires: For each finding record the source and its stable identity, severity, the fingerprint it was raised against, evidence, impact, the disposition, the rationale, the corrective change when the disposition is `fixed`, validation evidence that the change resolves the finding, and the reply or status URL once the operator has published.

clauses.title: Owner decision record names every field
requires:
Decision ID
Kind
Target and revision
Question
Options and trade-offs
Recommendation
Owner choice
Rationale
Validity and invalidation conditions

clauses.title: Risk-based test-first policy and truthful provenance
Issue readiness excludes external gates
requires: are not part of issue readiness

clauses.title: Review-only prohibitions
requires: do not edit any file in the repository
do not reply to review threads
do not mutate any external service
